brief:
An Israeli settler struck a Palestinian child with a vehicle in Abu Njeim village, southeast of Bethlehem in the West Bank, on Tuesday, Shehab Wire reported. The incident occurred while the settler was in the village.

Local sources confirmed the child was hit by the vehicle. The settler's identity and the circumstances surrounding the incident were not immediately clear.

No details on the child's condition or injuries were available at the time of reporting.

title: Israeli settler runs over Palestinian child in Bethlehem village
